About Us

Four decades of manufacturing excellence

Established over 40 years ago, Ashok Industries is a manufacturer based in Gujarat, specializing in cast iron (CI) products, industrial valves and CNC-machined components. With decades of manufacturing experience, we are committed to delivering dependable products that meet the diverse requirements of our customers.

Our CNC machining capabilities complement our manufacturing operations, helping us deliver products with reliable fit and finish. We focus on manufacturing expertise, consistent product quality and long-term customer relationships.
